scope: Saved ten-case Bedrock batch, five repeats per variant, latest repair when present. No new API calls.
primary_unit: Overall grounding obligation per repeated evaluator report; three-class exact accuracy, incorrect as positive for precision/recall.

exclusions.reason: Card changed or was added after these evaluations. No historical prediction is remapped to a new obligation.
exclusions.status_scoring: Entire case excluded from status/all-field comparison because its card/specification inventory changed.
